wikis.title: JFK New Terminal One delayed, $6 billion debt and Moody's outlook cut
wikis.summary: Simple Flying, 15 June 2026: JFK's New Terminal One opening slipped from June to November 2026 at the earliest, prompting Moody's to move the project's outlook to negative.
wikis.body:
- Published Jun 15, 2026 by Daniel S Osipov (Simple Flying).
- Cost and debt: total project estimated at $9.5 billion; $5.9 billion in bonds, total debt over $6 billion. Full completion in 2030.
- Delay: initial opening targeted June 2026 (14 new gates plus new departures and arrivals hall) pushed to "November 2026 at the earliest"; initial demand forecast trimmed. Another five gates open in 2028 and the remaining four in 2030.
- Moody's Ratings changed JFK NTO LLC's outlook from stable to negative while retaining Baa3 (lowest investment grade). Concerns: construction delay and lower demand after opening.
- Liquidity: $500 million ramp-up reserve plus $250 million of available lines of credit.
- Developer: New Terminal One LLC consortium of Ferrovial Airports, JLC Infrastructure, Ullico and Carlyle Group; JFK NTO LLC holds a lease from the Port Authority until 2060. Details first unveiled 2018, full project announced 2021.
- Terminal: 23 gates (22 widebody-capable, two able to take the A380), 2.6 million sq ft (241,000 sq m), up to 23 million passengers, over 300,000 sq ft of retail; 29 airlines agreed (24 announced, listed incl. Air China, KLM, Qatar Airways, Korean Air, Air New Zealand).
- Financed as a largely private public-private partnership repaid from terminal revenue, not by the Port Authority; the article says there is no risk of default but investor confidence is declining.

wikis.summary: Trafikverket's project page for the E4 Stockholm bypass (Förbifart Stockholm), a 21 km link with 18 km of tunnels.
wikis.body:
- Förbifart Stockholm is a new route for the E4 past Stockholm, connecting southern and northern parts of the county; just over 18 km of the 21 km are in tunnels. It would be one of the longest road tunnels in the world.
- Land acquisition plan adopted and approved by the government; first main contracts started construction in 2015; the project "will take approximately 15 years to finish".
- Trafikverket estimates about 140,000 vehicles per day by 2035.
- In brief: length 21 km; tunnels 18 km; two separate tunnel tubes; max speed 80/100 km/h; construction cost SEK 41.7 bn (2021 prices).
- Project Director: Anders Selström.

wikis.title: Förbifart Stockholm (Stockholm Bypass) - Wikipedia
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on the Stockholm Bypass tunnel motorway, covering its history, route, cost and schedule changes, and criticism.
wikis.body:
- Underground motorway between Kungens Kurva (south) and Häggvik (north); more than 17 of 21 km underground; deepest point 65 m below sea level and Lake Mälaren; 140,000 vehicles per day expected.
- Government permitted construction on 3 September 2009. Groundbreaking 19 August 2014; new government halted it on 23 October 2014 for half a year, then restarted (early 2015).
- Cost/timeline changes: 2009 estimate SEK 27 bn (about $3.5bn) with 8 years expected; later 10 years and 34 bn kronor with tunnel excavation from 2016; "As of the end of 2019, the expected completion time is 14 years, year 2030 and the cost 37 billion kronor". In 2019 delays and work-safety violations cancelled one tunnel contract.
- Planning since 1966; Essingeleden (opened 1967, designed for 80,000 vehicles/day) now carries twice that.
- Routes: south part from Kungens Kurva underground past Lovön, Grimsta Nature Reserve, to Akalla; north part Akalla to south of Häggvik above ground.
- Supporters cite access and reduced transit load; critics cite CO2 emissions, cost and environmental impact. Uppdrag granskning criticised it as "The most expensive Swedish expressway".

wikis.title: Vancouver's Broadway SkyTrain extension delayed to fall 2027
wikis.summary: CBC, 25 May 2024: B.C. government says the Broadway Subway will open fall 2027, another year late, due to slower tunnelling and excavation.
wikis.body:
- Posted May 25, 2024 by Isaac Phan Nay (CBC News).
- Opening now "scheduled to be in service fall 2027", delayed a further year. Earlier: construction started 2020 with a five-year estimate; in 2022 a five-week concrete workers' strike pushed it to 2026.
- Causes: tunnelling under the existing Canada Line, relocating major utilities and installing traffic decks to keep Broadway open (Lisa Gow, Broadway Subway Project).
- Project extends the Millennium Line 5.7 km from VCC-Clark station to Arbutus Street.
- Business impact: Green's Organic and Natural Market owner Sentheepan Senthivel estimates 40 per cent lost sales each year; Gow said "The province doesn't provide compensation for businesses or residents during construction".

wikis.body:

- From VCC-Clark Station on 700 m of elevated guideway, then 5 km underground along Broadway; 6 new underground stations, interim terminus at Arbutus Street; a future phase could extend to UBC Point Grey. B-Line bus continues between Arbutus and UBC.
- Broadway corridor: busiest bus route in Canada and the USA, over 100,000 transit trips a day.
- Starting July 16, 2026, some bus stops near Broadway and Cambie are temporarily moved (routes 9, 99, N9, 15, 17, N15).

wikis.title: Mumbai–Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail progress, August 2026
wikis.summary: Railway Supply article on MAHSR construction progress, the expected 2027 first service, and why the final completion date and cost remain unset.
wikis.body:
## Progress (parliamentary updates, 27 Mar vs 29 Jul 2026)
- Piers 430 km to 452 km (+22 km); girders 341 to 356 km (+15); track bed 174 to 209 km (+35); OHE masts 153 to 190 km (+37).
- All civil works complete on the 97 km Surat–Vapi section, including river bridges; track bed there at 86%.
- Track work started at Surat, Bilimora and Bharuch stations.

## Schedule statements
- August 2025 Lok Sabha reply: Vapi–Sabarmati planned for completion by December 2027; entire BKC–Sabarmati by December 2029.
- NHSRCL June 2026 overview: first high-speed service expected to commence in August 2027.
- March 2026: ministry did not fix August 2027 as exact completion; exact timeline can be ascertained only after civil, track, electrical, signalling, telecom and trainset work is completed.

## Cost
- ₹86,939 crore spent through 31 December 2025 (February 2026 parliamentary answer); final cost not yet ascertainable.
- JICA 2023 ex-ante evaluation retained an estimate of ¥1.806282 trillion (feasibility-study basis), under review by India and Japan.

## Remaining systems
- J-Slab ballastless track; 2×25 kV overhead traction with 14 traction and 16 distribution substations planned.
- Signalling package MAHSR-S-1 (signalling, telecom, operations control centre).
- Japan agreed to introduce E10 Shinkansen trains; no trainset delivery date given in the official sources reviewed.
- Maharashtra: about 21 km underground BKC–Shilphata (about 5 km NATM, 16 km TBM); 4.8 km completed between Ghansoli and Shilphata. First TBM began a 6 km drive from Vikhroli toward BKC on 5 July; a second started from Ghansoli toward Vikhroli on 18 July.

The article says this is not a new delay without further evidence.

- Originally promoted under the Labor Government at around $5.4 billion with a 2024 delivery date.
- December 2024: Crisafulli Government said costs would exceed $17 billion.
- After 11 months of negotiations with contractors and a schedule 'reset', cost around $19 billion, passenger services expected to begin in 2029.

wikis.title: MWRD update on the Tunnel and Reservoir Plan and McCook Stage 2 delay
wikis.summary: MWRD press release saying TARP is complete except McCook Reservoir Stage 2, whose online date has slipped to Dec. 31, 2032.
wikis.body:
- Published August 15, 2025 by the Metropolitan Water Reclamation District of Greater Chicago (MWRD).
- TARP ("Deep Tunnel"), begun in 1972, is complete and fully operational except McCook Reservoir Stage 2.
- McCook Reservoir, in Bedford Park between the Chicago Sanitary and Ship Canal and Des Plaines River: Stage 1 completed in 2017, 3.5 billion gallons; Stage 2 adds 6.5 billion gallons for a total of 10 billion gallons, "the largest reservoir of its kind". Serves 3.1 million people in Chicago and 36 suburban municipalities.
- Stage 2 is an active stone quarry excavated by Vulcan Materials Company; mining pace depends on stone demand.
- Original schedule (federal consent decree of Jan. 6, 2014): mining done by Dec. 31, 2028, operational by Dec. 31, 2029.
- Because of slowed stone demand, current estimate for Stage 2 going online is Dec. 31, 2032. MWRD says it has met or exceeded all consent decree requirements and that such delays were anticipated.
- Stage 1 has captured approximately 130 billion gallons of stormwater and wastewater.

wikis.title: McCook Reservoir, Chicago: how it was built
wikis.summary: Municipal Water Leader article on MWRD's McCook Reservoir, its construction, staging, sealing, cost and benefits.
wikis.body:
- First stormwater entered the reservoir after an inch of rain one early January; the reservoir held its 3.5 billion gallons for the first time on February 19-20.
- TARP Phase 1: 109 miles of deep tunnels and more than 400 drop shafts; Phase 2: three reservoirs, McCook the last.
- Construction began in 1999 on the 3.5-billion-gallon (10,741 acre-feet) first stage; quarry operator began mining stone in 2008. First stage is 35 percent of total planned volume.
- Two 33-foot-diameter tunnels enter (Wilmette mainstream tunnel; Des Plaines River tunnel); a third drains it to the pump station for return to the Stickney Water Reclamation Plant.
- About 10 million cubic yards of overburden removed; excavation goes 300 feet below ground.
- Quarry operator pays MWRD a small royalty; MWRD covers costs beyond a normal mining project.
- Sealing: double-row grout curtain (5 ft spacing) around the 3-mile perimeter down to shale about 350 feet down, plus a 3-foot bentonite slurry wall.
- Total cost projected around $1 billion, partly cost-shared with the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers; financed with low-interest bonds.
- Per MWRD engineer Kevin Fitzpatrick: benefit-cost ratio above 3, 100+ year life, 250-square-mile area, more than 3 million people, over $140 million per year in flooding and pollution reduction benefits when complete.

wikis.title: Bangkok–Nong Khai high-speed railway (Wikipedia)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on Thailand's first high-speed line (Northeastern HSR), its phases, costs, delays, contracts and progress as of March 2026.
wikis.body:
## Overview
- Under construction, Thailand's first high-speed line; operator State Railway of Thailand; standard gauge 1,435 mm; operating speed 250 km/h; two tracks. Also called Northeastern high-speed rail line / China–Thailand railway.
- Phase 1 Bangkok (Krung Thep Aphiwat) to Nakhon Ratchasima: 253 km; work began 21 December 2017; only 52.4% complete as of March 2026 due to multiple delays; operations expected 2030 (infobox planned opening 2031). Estimated cost 179 billion baht.
- Phase 2 Nakhon Ratchasima to Nong Khai: about 357 km (356 km in infobox); approved by Thai Cabinet 4 February 2025; about 341 billion baht; operations expected 2031; estimated start 2026 (also stated as slated 2025 to 2030).
- Phase 3 Nong Khai to Vientiane (16 km): not confirmed.
- Rolling stock: CRRC Fuxing Hao CR300AF (max 300 km/h, 250 km/h in Thailand).

## History
- Planned by parliament in 2010; 2014 coup deferred plans; Nov 2014 MoU with China; Nov 2015 four-phase split; 2016 formal agreement. Thailand chose to pay the whole project cost. China to operate and maintain for the first three years, shared years three to seven, then Thailand alone.
- Phase 1 officially launched October 2020. In Q4 2022 it was 15% complete when it should have been 37%; originally due 2026, delayed to 2027 (attributed to COVID-19); earlier estimate US$5.1 billion.
- Sikhio crane collapse: on 14 January 2026 a crane working on the project collapsed and hit a passenger train, killing at least 32 people.

## Contracts (progress Nov 2024 to Nov 2025)
- 4-2 Don Mueang–Nawa Nakhon 1.45% to 8.12%; 4-3 Nawa Nakhon–Ban Pho 44.59% to 62.18%; 4-4 Chiang Rak Noi depot 26.36% to 52.26%; 4-6 Phra Kaeo–Saraburi 8.57% to 16.26%; 4-7 Saraburi–Kaeng Khoi 60.50% to 68.79%; 3-1 2.81% to 24.35%; 3-2 Muak Lek–Lam Takhong tunnel 81.41% to 99.60%; 3-3 55.35% to 59.41%; 3-4 82.55% to 99.45%; 3-5 Khok Kruat–Nakhon Ratchasima 11.92% to 16.27%; 1-1 and 2-1 100% complete; 4-1 and 4-5 at 0%.
- Phase 1 stations: Krung Thep Aphiwat, Don Mueang, Ayutthaya, Saraburi, Pak Chong, Nakhon Ratchasima (250.5 km from Bangkok).

wikis.title: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina: overview, characters, novels, manga and anime announcements
wikis.summary: Wikipedia's overview of the light novel series, its plot, characters, light novel and manga releases, the 2020 TV anime and the January 2026 announcement of a new anime film.
wikis.body:
- Japanese light novel series (Majo no Tabitabi) by Jōgi Shiraishi, illustrated by Azure. SB Creative publishes it under GA Novel since April 15, 2016; 25 volumes as of March 14, 2026 (volume 25 released March 14, 2026). Yen Press licenses it in North America (first volume January 28, 2020).
- Plot: inspired by stories of the traveling witch Niké, Elaina becomes the youngest apprentice witch to pass the sorcery exam; rejected for training because of her talents, she is accepted by Fran, the "Stardust Witch", and after earning the title "Ashen Witch" travels the world meeting all kinds of people and places. The story is told through her diary entries.
- Characters: Elaina; Fran (the Stardust Witch, her mentor, a former apprentice of Niké); Saya (later the "Charcoal Witch"); Sheila (the "Night Witch", of the United Magic Association, also a former apprentice of Niké); Mina (voiced by Minami Takahashi, Saya's younger sister).
- Manga: art by Itsuki Nanao on Square Enix's Manga Up! from November 29, 2018 to March 28, 2024; six tankōbon volumes (April 12, 2019 to July 5, 2024; volume 6 in English August 19, 2025). Spin-off Riviere and the Land of Prayer: light novel since January 14, 2022 (3 volumes), manga by Neriume on Piccoma December 17, 2021 to January 26, 2024 (3 volumes), both licensed by Yen Press.
- Anime TV series: announced October 19, 2019 at "GA Fes 2019"; animated by C2C, directed by Toshiyuki Kubooka, series composition Kazuyuki Fudeyasu, character designs Takeshi Oda, music AstroNotes; 12 episodes aired October 2 to December 18, 2020 on AT-X and other channels. Opening "Literature" by Reina Ueda; ending "Haiiro no Saga" by ChouCho. Streamed by Funimation (English dub from December 4, 2020), AnimeLab, Wakanim; later moved to Crunchyroll; Muse Communication licensed it for Southeast and South Asia.
- "A new anime film was announced during the 'GA Fes 2026: GA 20th Anniversary' livestream event on January 4, 2026."

wikis.title: Sound Transit delays West Seattle Link Extension from 2032 to 2035
wikis.summary: Construction Dive brief reporting Sound Transit pushed the West Seattle Link opening from 2032 to 2035, with construction starting in 2028.
wikis.body:
- Published Sept. 9, 2026 (Sebastian Obando).
- Sound Transit moved the West Seattle Link Extension opening from 2032 to 2035, per a statement; construction will start in 2028.
- Cause: cost-savings analysis and a longer construction schedule for complex portions (bridge construction, extended tunnel section). Statement: "The primary factor that caused a shift in the anticipated revenue service date from 2032 to 2035 was time taken to analyze cost savings opportunities."
- After a September 2024 estimate found the project unaffordable under the long-range finance plan, savings work found more than $2 billion in potential cuts, including elimination of the proposed Avalon Station.
- ST3 program (funds West Seattle and Everett Link) has an estimated $34.5 billion funding gap over 20 years; total ST3 cost has ballooned to $185 billion per the Seattle Times.
- Procurement: Duwamish River Crossing and Guideways advertised in June; SODO Station in August; trackwork/systems and Alaska Junction Station packages due in October; design-bid-build for West Seattle tunnels and Delridge Station in late 2027 and early 2028.

wikis.title: Kystverket: ready to build the Stad Ship Tunnel
wikis.summary: Norwegian Coastal Administration news that it is ready to award the main contract and begin Stad Ship Tunnel construction in early 2027 once the budget passes.
wikis.body:
- Centre-left parties agreed a revised national budget including funding to start construction; final approval by Stortinget scheduled by 19 June.
- Director General Einar Vik Arset: ready to facilitate "a construction start in the beginning of 2027".
- Bid evaluation complete for the main contract; final bids received in April from AF Gruppen, Eiffage Génie Civil, and the Skanska/Vassbakk & Stol consortium. Tender ran nearly two years. After award there is a standstill period for complaints, then signing. Project Manager: Harald Inge Johnsen.
- Other contracts ready to tender: demolition of buildings near the site and new water pipelines on both sides.
- Tunnel: world's first full-scale ship tunnel, turnkey contract; at the narrowest point of the Stad Peninsula between Moldefjord and Kjødepollen in Vanylvsfjord; 1.7 km long (2.2 km with entrance areas), 50 m high, 36 m wide; fits vessels up to Coastal Route/Hurtigruten size.
- Aim: improve navigability and safety around Stad, described as likely the most weather-exposed and dangerous stretch of sea along the Norwegian coast.
- The page gives no explicit publication date.

wikis.title: Norway clears funding for the Stad Ship Tunnel (Interesting Engineering)
wikis.summary: Interesting Engineering report that Norway's revised budget deal funds the Stad Ship Tunnel, with construction expected to begin in early 2027.
wikis.body:
- Published Jun 19, 2026 (Georgina Jedikovska).
- Kystverket says it is ready to sign with the winning contractor; expects construction to begin in early 2027. Center-left parties agreed to include funding in the revised national budget; final parliamentary approval expected by June 19.
- Tunnel: on the Stadlandet Peninsula, 1.1 miles (1.7 km) through rock, 1.37 miles (2.2 km) with entrances; 164 ft (50 m) high, 118 ft (36 m) wide; connects Moldefjord and Kjødepollen in Vanylvsfjord; fits Hurtigruten-size vessels. First mentioned in an 1874 newspaper article.
- Bypasses the Stadhavet Sea, with more than 30 maritime deaths since World War II. About 81 percent of today's ship traffic will be able to use it; cruise ships reportedly limited to eight knots, passage about 10 minutes.
- About three million cubic meters of rock (around 750,000 truckloads) by conventional drill-and-blast through hard gneiss.
- Bidders: AF Gruppen, Eiffage Génie Civil, and a Skanska/Vassbakk & Stol joint venture; evaluation complete, then a standstill period for complaints. Demolition and water-infrastructure contracts ready to tender.

wikis.title: Cranky Flier on the LAX people mover (SkyLink) saga
wikis.summary: Cranky Flier post setting the stage on the delayed LAX SkyLink people mover, the LAMP program, and the LAWA versus LINXS dispute, with reader comments.
wikis.body:
- Published Jul 23, 2026 (Cranky Flier, Brett).
- The people mover "was originally supposed to open in March 2023, and at last check, the posted date is now October 2026. That probably won't happen either."
- Author describes a "terrible, vicious battle" between Los Angeles World Airports (LAWA) and LINXS, a contractor joint venture; a first lawsuit has been filed. This post only sets the stage; a follow-up on what went wrong was promised "next week".
- Part of the Landside Access Modernization Program (LAMP): a consolidated rental car center on the former Manchester Square neighborhood (described as the second largest concrete building in the US behind the Pentagon); the LAX/Metro Transit Center linking the K (Crenshaw) and C (Green) light rail lines; the Intermodal Transportation Facility - West (economy parking, hotel shuttles, park and ride); three stops inside the central terminal area running up the spine; 98th Street extended through; Sepulveda Blvd reconfiguration.
- Until SkyLink opens, shuttles still flood the horseshoe and Metro riders take a slow bus to terminals.
- The 100+ reader comments (mostly opinion) include claims such as LAX pushing 7+ years versus about 4 years for TPA and PHX systems; these are commenter statements, not the article's.

wikis.title: LAX Automated People Mover still not open: $3.34 billion, $1.49 billion per mile
wikis.summary: Westside Current article on the LAX people mover's cost and repeated delays, compared with peer airport trains, as of March 2026.
wikis.body:
- Published Mar 25, 2026 (Current Staff).
- LAX built a 2.25-mile airport train for about $3.34 billion but passengers still cannot use it; in testing as of March 2026, after missing its original opening target and a January 2026 operations date LAWA announced in 2024.
- Driverless train on a 2.25-mile elevated guideway with six stations connecting terminals to Metro, parking, pickup/drop-off areas and the consolidated rental car facility.
- July 2024 (FOXLA): airport commissioners approved a settlement with the LINXS consortium pushing total cost to roughly $3.34 billion, about $1.49 billion per mile.
- Peers: Phoenix PHX Sky Train about five miles, first two stages $884 million plus final stage $745 million (about $1.63 billion total); Miami MIA Mover 1.25 miles, about $270 million.
- The 2024-25 Los Angeles County Civil Grand Jury (per LAist) found delays from a strained LAWA–LINXS relationship, inadequate conflict-resolution processes and political pressure; subcontractors still dispute parts of the 2024 settlement.
- NBC Los Angeles reported days earlier that test runs were seen; LAWA's project page still describes it as forthcoming. The article is opinionated in calling it a badly managed project.

wikis.title: OpenAI announces GPT-4o ("Hello GPT-4o")
wikis.summary: OpenAI's May 13, 2024 announcement of GPT-4o, a multimodal flagship model, with capabilities, tokenizer gains, safety evaluation and rollout plans.
wikis.body:
- Dated May 13, 2024. GPT-4o ("o" for "omni") is the new flagship model that "can reason across audio, vision, and text in real time"; accepts any combination of text, audio, image and video and generates text, audio and image outputs.
- Audio response as little as 232 ms, average 320 ms. Matches GPT-4 Turbo on English text and code, better on non-English text, vision and audio; "much faster and 50% cheaper in the API".
- Previously Voice Mode had average latencies of 2.8 seconds (GPT-3.5) and 5.4 seconds (GPT-4) using a three-model pipeline; GPT-4o is one model trained end-to-end across text, vision and audio.
- New tokenizer uses fewer tokens across 20 languages, e.g. Gujarati 4.4x fewer (145 to 33), Telugu 3.5x, Tamil 3.3x, Hindi 2.9x, Arabic 2.0x, Chinese 1.4x, English 1.1x (27 to 24).
- Safety: evaluated under the Preparedness Framework; no category above Medium risk (cybersecurity, CBRN, persuasion, model autonomy); scorecard (updated May 8, 2024) shows persuasion Medium, others Low; 70+ external red-team experts.
- Availability: text and image inputs and text outputs released that day; text and image rolling out in ChatGPT, in the free tier and to Plus users with up to 5x higher message limits; new Voice Mode with GPT-4o in alpha for ChatGPT Plus "in the coming weeks"; audio outputs at launch limited to preset voices.
- API: text and vision model, 2x faster, half the price and 5x higher rate limits than GPT-4 Turbo; audio and video support planned for a small group of trusted partners "in the coming weeks".
- The page carries a note that it introduced GPT-4o in 2024 and points to GPT-6 as OpenAI's latest model.

wikis.title: OpenAI Model Release Notes (ChatGPT and API model changes, July 2024 to August 2026)
wikis.summary: OpenAI Help Center changelog of model releases, updates, retirements and Model Spec changes, newest first, from GPT-4o mini (July 18, 2024) to the Model Spec update of August 18, 2026.
wikis.body:
Page says "Updated: 22 days ago". Entries are dated, newest first.

## Most recent entries
- **Model Spec update (August 18, 2026):** more clarity on appropriate relational interactions for teens; clarifies handling of false or unsupported premises; removes outdated guidance for pre-reasoning models; adds section "Be clear about capabilities and limits".
- **GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT (July 9, 2026):** rollout begins of "our flagship reasoning model for complex work across coding, research, science, cybersecurity, computer use, and design". Rolling out to eligible paid plans; Free, Go and logged-out users not included.
- **GPT-5.5 Instant update (May 28, 2026):** better style and quality in ChatGPT and API; canvas no longer available in GPT-5.5 Instant or GPT-5.5 Thinking (writing and code blocks in chat instead).
- **Retiring o3 and GPT-4.5 (May 28, 2026):** o3 retires from ChatGPT on August 26, 2026 (90-day sunset); GPT-4.5 on June 27, 2026 (30-day sunset). ChatGPT only, no API change.
- **GPT-5.4 mini in ChatGPT (March 18, 2026):** available to Free and Go via "Thinking" in the + menu; rate-limit fallback for GPT-5.4 Thinking for others; GPT-5 Thinking mini retires in 30 days.
- **GPT-5.3 Instant updates (March 3 and March 16, 2026):** more accurate answers, better web search results, fewer dead ends and caveats; March 16 update reduces teaser-style phrasing.
- **GPT-5.1 retired (March 11, 2026):** GPT-5.1 Instant, Thinking and Pro no longer in ChatGPT; conversations move to GPT-5.3 Instant, GPT-5.4 Thinking or GPT-5.4 Pro.
- **GPT-5.4 Thinking (March 5, 2026):** combines recent reasoning, coding and agentic advances and GPT-5.3-Codex coding; can give an upfront plan of its thinking; improved deep web research and context management.
- **GPT-4o and legacy retirement (February 13, 2026):** GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini, o4-mini and GPT-5 (Instant and Thinking) retired from ChatGPT; no API changes at that time (announced January 29, 2026).
- **GPT-5.2 Instant update (February 10, 2026):** more measured, grounded tone; clearer answers to advice and how-to questions.
- **GPT-5.3-Codex (February 5, 2026):** "most capable agentic coding model yet", first to combine Codex and GPT-5 training stacks, "~ 25% faster".
- **GPT-5.2 Thinking time settings (Jan 10 to February 4, 2026):** Standard and Light thinking time lowered; Extended unintentionally lowered then restored on February 4.
- **5.2 personality update (January 22, 2026):** GPT-5.2 Instant default personality more conversational.

## Model Spec updates
- December 18, 2025: new Under-18 (U18) Principles for teens aged 13-17.
- October 27, 2025: expanded mental health guidance (delusions, mania), new "Respect real-world ties" section, clarified delegation in Chain of Command.
- September 12, 2025: top authority level renamed Platform to Root; order Root, System, Developer, User, Guideline; agentic principles; refusal style becomes "safe completion".

## 2025 releases
- GPT-5.1-Codex-Max (November 19, 2025): frontier agentic coding model for long-running work, uses compaction; same rates as GPT-5.1-Codex.
- GPT-5-Codex-Mini: smaller, up to 4x more usage; offered at 90% of 5-hour limit.
- GPT-5 Instant distress-support update (October 3, 2025).
- GPT-5-codex: introduced September 15, 2025; in Responses API September 23, 2025; not in ChatGPT.
- GPT-5: rolling out to Plus, Pro, Team and Free; new default; single auto-switching system; GPT-5 Thinking Pro for Pro and Team.
- gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b open-weight models (August 5, 2025).
- o3-pro (June 10, 2025) for Pro users and API, replacing o1-pro in the picker.
- Advanced Voice upgrade with translation (June 7, 2025); o4-mini snapshot rolled back (June 6, 2025).
- GPT-4.1 in ChatGPT for paid users and GPT-4.1 mini replacing GPT-4o mini (May 14, 2025).
- GPT-4o sycophancy update reverted (April 29, 2025); GPT-4o improvements on April 25, March 27, May 12.
- o3 and o4-mini (April 16, 2025); GPT-4.5 research preview (February 27, 2025) for Pro; o3-mini (January 31, 2025), 56% expert preference over o1-mini.
- GPT-4o update extending training cutoff from November 2023 to June 2024 (January 29, 2025); scheduled tasks beta (January 14, 2025).

## 2024 releases
- GPT-4o mini (July 18, 2024); GPT-4o updates (August 12, September 3, November 20, 2024); o1-preview and o1-mini (September 12, 2024; weekly limits 30 and 50 messages); advanced voice (September 24, 2024); canvas (October 3, 2024); GPT-4o mini update (November 5, 2024).

wikis.title: OpenAI announces GPT-4o mini
wikis.summary: OpenAI's July 18, 2024 announcement of GPT-4o mini, a low-cost small model with benchmark results, pricing and availability.
wikis.body:
- Published July 18, 2024 by OpenAI.
- GPT-4o mini is "our most cost-efficient small model"; scores 82% on MMLU; outperforms GPT-4 on chat preferences in LMSYS leaderboard.
- Price: 15 cents per million input tokens and 60 cents per million output tokens; "more than 60% cheaper than GPT-3.5 Turbo".
- Context window 128K tokens, up to 16K output tokens per request, knowledge up to October 2023. Text and vision in the API; text, image, video and audio inputs and outputs "coming in the future".
- Benchmarks: MMLU 82.0% (Gemini Flash 77.9%, Claude Haiku 73.8%); MGSM 87.0% (75.5%, 71.7%); HumanEval 87.2% (71.5%, 75.9%); MMMU 59.4% (56.1%, 50.2%).
- Partners Ramp and Superhuman found it significantly better than GPT-3.5 Turbo for extracting structured data from receipts and generating email replies.
- Safety: same mitigations as GPT-4o; first model in the API to apply the instruction hierarchy method against jailbreaks and prompt injections.
- Availability: Assistants API, Chat Completions API and Batch API; fine-tuning planned "in the coming days". In ChatGPT, Free, Plus and Team users get it that day in place of GPT-3.5; Enterprise the following week.
- Cost per token has dropped 99% since text-davinci-003.

- Light novel by Akumi Agitogi, illustrated by Tsukiho Tsukioka; online on Shōsetsuka ni Narō, then Fujimi Shobo (Fujimi L Bunko) since January 15, 2019; ten volumes as of March 2026 (volume 10 released March 13, 2026); English by Yen Press (volume 9 in English March 10, 2026).
- Synopsis: in an alternative Taishō era where spirits and magic are real but declining, Miyo Saimori, born without supernatural talent and mistreated by her stepmother, is betrothed to Kiyoka Kudou, a commander so cold and cruel that previous would-be brides fled within three days.
- Manga by Rito Kohsaka on Square Enix's Gangan Online since December 20, 2018; six volumes as of March 2026; English licensed July 2021 by Square Enix Manga & Books; art book August 10, 2023.
- Live-action film: announced April 25, 2022; directed by Ayuko Tsukahara; released in Japan March 17, 2023 by Toho (115 minutes); theme "Tapestry" by Snow Man; English title As Long as We Both Shall Live. Opening weekend box office 654 million yen (479,700 admissions), 2.8 billion yen in Japan by December 2023.
- Anime: announced April 5, 2022; Kinema Citrus, director Takehiro Kubota, music Evan Call; season 1 aired July 5 to September 20, 2023 (Netflix simulcast globally, Bilibili in mainland China). Season 2 (Masayuki Kojima co-directing) aired January 6 to April 9, 2025; 26 episodes total.
- Special: after the season 2 finale a new project was announced; "In November 2025, it was announced to be a three-episode special that is set to premiere in Japan on October 25, 2026, and will stream worldwide on Netflix." Ending theme "Prelude no Temae ni: for me&you" by Kashitarō Itō.
- Stage play Watashi no Shiawase na Kekkon: Teito Rikugun Okutsuki Kitan ran August 11-20, 2023 at Theater 1010, Tokyo.
- Accolades: manga eighth in the sixth Next Manga Awards (2020); sixth in Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2021 for female readers; nominated for best shōjo manga at the 46th Kodansha Manga Award; anime nominated at the 8th Crunchyroll Anime Awards (Best Romance, Best Drama, 2024).

wikis.title: Sycophancy in GPT-4o: what happened and what OpenAI is doing
wikis.summary: OpenAI's April 29, 2025 explanation of rolling back an overly flattering GPT-4o update and the steps planned to address it.
wikis.body:
- Published April 29, 2025.
- OpenAI rolled back "last week's GPT-4o update" in ChatGPT; users are back on an earlier version with more balanced behavior. The removed update was "overly flattering or agreeable".
- Cause: the update "focused too much on short-term feedback" (thumbs-up/thumbs-down signals) and did not account for how interactions evolve over time, so GPT-4o skewed towards responses "overly supportive but disingenuous".
- Context: 500 million people use ChatGPT each week.
- Fixes: refine training techniques and system prompts; more guardrails for honesty and transparency per the Model Spec; more user testing before deployment; expanded evaluations.
- Weighting feedback toward long-term user satisfaction; more personalization: real-time feedback, multiple default personalities, custom instructions; exploring democratic feedback.

wikis.title: Introducing GPT-4.1 in the API
wikis.summary: OpenAI's April 14, 2025 launch of GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini and GPT-4.1 nano in the API with benchmarks, 1 million token context, and pricing.
wikis.body:
- Published April 14, 2025. Three API models: GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini, GPT-4.1 nano (first nano model). Up to 1 million tokens of context (up from 128,000), knowledge cutoff June 2024.
- GPT-4.1 is API-only; improvements are gradually going into the latest GPT-4o in ChatGPT.
- GPT-4.5 Preview deprecated in the API, to be turned off July 14, 2025.
## Headline results
- SWE-bench Verified 54.6% (GPT-4o 33.2%; 52.1% if 23 omitted of 500 problems scored 0). MultiChallenge 38.3% (+10.5% abs over GPT-4o). IFEval 87.4% vs 81.0%. Video-MME long no-subtitles 72.0% (GPT-4o 65.3%).
- Extraneous code edits fell from 9% (GPT-4o) to 2%. Output token limit raised to 32,768 (from 16,384).
- GPT-4.1 mini: matches or exceeds GPT-4o on intelligence evals, "reducing latency by nearly half and reducing cost by 83%".
- GPT-4.1 nano: 80.1% MMLU, 50.3% GPQA, 9.8% Aider polyglot; aimed at classification or autocompletion.
- Graphwalks BFS <128k: 61.7% for GPT-4.1. Open-sourced evals: OpenAI-MRCR and Graphwalks.
- Latency to first token about fifteen seconds at 128,000 tokens and a minute at a million for GPT-4.1.
## Partner results
Windsurf (60% higher than GPT-4o on internal coding benchmark), Qodo (better suggestion in 55% of 200 PRs), Blue J (53% more accurate), Hex (nearly 2x on SQL eval), Thomson Reuters (17% better multi-document review), Carlyle (50% better retrieval).
## Pricing (per 1M tokens: input / cached input / output)
- gpt-4.1: $2.00 / $0.50 / $8.00; gpt-4.1-mini: $0.40 / $0.10 / $1.60; gpt-4.1-nano: $0.10 / $0.025 / $0.40.
- GPT-4.1 is 26% cheaper than GPT-4o for median queries; prompt caching discount 75%; long context at no extra cost; Batch API a further 50% discount.

wikis.title: Introducing upgrades to Codex (GPT-5-Codex)
wikis.summary: OpenAI's September 15, 2025 release of GPT-5-Codex plus a rebuilt Codex CLI, IDE extension, cloud and code review features.
wikis.body:
- Published September 15, 2025; update September 23, 2025: GPT-5-Codex available via API key at the same price as GPT-5, in the Responses API only.
- GPT-5-Codex: a version of GPT-5 optimized for agentic coding; default for cloud tasks and code review; adjusts thinking time by task complexity. Worked independently for more than 7 hours in testing. For the bottom 10% of turns it uses 93.7% fewer tokens than GPT-5; top 10% think about twice as long.
- SWE-bench Verified now reported on all 500 tasks (previously 477).
- Codex CLI rebuilt: image attachments, to-do list, web search, MCP, three approval modes (read-only, auto, full access), conversation compaction.
- Codex IDE extension for VS Code, Cursor and other forks. Cloud: container caching cut median completion time by 90%.
- Code review: automatically reviews PRs when they move from draft to ready; "@codex review" mention; reviews the vast majority of OpenAI's PRs.
- Safety: sandbox with network disabled by default; GPT-5-Codex treated as High capability in Biological and Chemical domains.
- Included in ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, Edu and Enterprise plans. Recommended only for agentic coding in Codex-like environments.

wikis.title: Lord of Mysteries (Wikipedia article on the web novel and its adaptations)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on the Chinese web novel Lord of Mysteries by Cuttlefish That Loves Diving, its English print release, manhua, the B.CMAY PICTURES donghua (season 1 in 2025) and its planned ten-year release roadmap through 2035.
wikis.body:
- Chinese web novel (诡秘之主, Guǐ Mì Zhī Zhǔ) by Yuan Ye / Cuttlefish That Loves Diving; serialized on Qidian April 1, 2018 to May 1, 2020 (chapters 1 to 213 of volume 1 are titled "The Clown"); print by China Literature Ltd; English print by Yen Press from July 29, 2025. Blends steampunk, Lovecraftian horror and Xuanhuan in a Victorian-inspired world; followed by Circle of Inevitability.
- Plot: on 28 June, year 1349 of the Fifth Epoch, Zhou Mingrui transmigrates into the body of Klein Moretti; he forms the "Tarot Club" while masquerading as a god-like entity, and becomes a Beyonder (person with mystical powers) affiliated with the Seven Orthodox Churches.
- English print schedule: The Clown Part I July 29, 2025; Part II December 9, 2025; Part III May 12, 2026; The Faceless Part I September 8, 2026.
- Manhua: serialization began January 21, 2020 on Bilibili Manhua; a new adaptation began in 2025 on AC.QQ.
- Donghua: produced by B.CMAY PICTURES, directed by Xiong Ke with Yuan Ye as series writer, streamed on WeTV and Crunchyroll. Season 1 "Clown" (volume 1, chapters 1-213) premiered as a double-episode special June 28, 2025 and ended September 13, 2025, 13 episodes; endings "Dark Dream" by Curley Gao and "THE ERASED" by Pu Yixing (final episode). Muse Communication uploaded episodes daily on YouTube October 1 to 13. Season 1 ends with Klein fatally stabbed by Ince.
- Ten-year roadmap (B.CMAY PICTURES): six seasons, three special episodes and a movie through 2035: 2025 Season 1 Clown (vol. 1); 2026 Special Episode 1 (Qilangos arc + City of Silver introductory arc); 2027 Season 2 Faceless (vol. 2); 2029 Special Episode 2; 2030 Season 3 Traveler (vol. 3); 2032 Season 4 Undying (vol. 4); 2033 Season 5 Red Priest (vol. 5); 2034 Seasons 6-7 (vols 6-7); 2035 LOTM Movie - The Fool Arc (vol. 8) and Special Episode 3 (TBD).
- Cast: Klein Moretti (Yang Kaiqi / Joshua Waters), Audrey Hall (Zhao Shuang / Alexis Tipton), Alger Wilson (Guo Haoran / Daniel Van Thomas), Dunn Smith (Wu Lei / Brian Mathis), among others.
- Video game: as of 2024 a multi-platform RPG titled Lord of the Mysteries is in development using Unreal Engine 5.
- Reception: ranked #1 on Qidian popularity for several consecutive months; tens of millions of readers as of 2023; one of 144 web novels in the National Library of China.

wikis.title: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max announcement
wikis.summary: OpenAI's November 19, 2025 release of GPT-5.1-Codex-Max, an agentic coding model using compaction for long-running tasks.
wikis.body:
- Published November 19, 2025. Available in Codex that day (CLI, IDE extension, cloud, code review); API access "coming soon".
- "Our new frontier agentic coding model"; first trained natively to work across multiple context windows via compaction, over millions of tokens; internal tasks running more than 24 hours.
- First model trained to operate in Windows environments.
- On SWE-bench Verified at medium effort it beats GPT-5.1-Codex using 30% fewer thinking tokens. New Extra High ('xhigh') reasoning effort; medium still recommended as daily driver.
- Evals (GPT-5.1-Codex high vs Max xhigh): SWE-bench Verified (n=500) 73.7% vs 77.9%; SWE-Lancer IC SWE 66.3% vs 79.9%; Terminal-Bench 2.0 52.8% vs 58.1%.
- Safety: does not reach High capability on Cybersecurity under the Preparedness Framework but is the most capable cyber model deployed to date; Codex sandbox by default (network off).
- Availability: Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, Enterprise plans; replaces GPT-5.1-Codex as default in Codex surfaces. Recommended only for agentic coding in Codex-like environments.
- Internally 95% of OpenAI engineers use Codex weekly and ship roughly 70% more pull requests.

wikis.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.5
wikis.summary: Anthropic's November 24, 2025 announcement of Claude Opus 4.5, with pricing, benchmark results, safety findings, the new effort parameter and product updates.
wikis.body:
- Published Nov 24, 2025. Available on Anthropic's apps, API and all three major cloud platforms; API name claude-opus-4-5-20251101.
- Pricing: $5/$25 per million tokens (input/output).
- Described as "the best model in the world for coding, agents, and computer use"; state-of-the-art on real-world software engineering tests.
- Scored higher than any human candidate ever on Anthropic's 2-hour performance engineering take-home exam (using parallel test-time compute; without a time limit it matched the best-ever human candidate).
- Benchmarks: leads 7 of 8 languages on SWE-bench Multilingual; 10.6% jump over Sonnet 4.5 on Aider Polyglot; earns 29% more than Sonnet 4.5 on Vending-Bench; Terminal Bench 15% improvement over Sonnet 4.5 (Warp testimonial).
- Effort parameter: at medium effort matches Sonnet 4.5's best SWE-bench Verified score with 76% fewer output tokens; at highest effort exceeds Sonnet 4.5 by 4.3 points using 48% fewer tokens.
- Safety: "the most robustly aligned model we have released to date"; harder to trick with prompt injection than any other frontier model (Gray Swan benchmark).
- Product updates: Plan Mode in Claude Code builds an editable plan.md; Claude Code in the desktop app; long conversations auto-summarize; Claude for Chrome to all Max users; Claude for Excel beta expanded to Max, Team and Enterprise; Opus-specific caps removed, usage limits raised for Max and Team Premium.
- Deep research evaluation improved from 70.48% to 85.30% using effort control, context compaction, and subagent management.
- Customer feedback quoted from GitHub Copilot, Lovable, Warp, Cursor, Notion and others (e.g. up to 65% fewer tokens).

wikis.title: Claude Opus product page (Opus 5 and earlier Opus releases)
wikis.summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus page listing Opus 5 as new, the Opus 4.5 to 4.8 release history, Opus 5 pricing and availability, and customer quotes.
wikis.body:
- Page header reads "Claude Opus 4.8 - Hybrid reasoning model built for serious coding and AI agents, featuring a 1M context window", while the page also announces "NEW Claude Opus 5" and its body text describes Opus 5.
- Release list: Opus 5 (new; "A step-change improvement for the Opus tier"); Opus 4.8 (May 28, 2026); Opus 4.7 (Apr 16, 2026); Opus 4.6 (Feb 5, 2026, "our most capable model to date" at the time); Opus 4.5 (Nov 24, 2025).
- Opus 5: available to Claude Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise users; on the Claude Platform, AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry; API name claude-opus-5.
- Pricing: from $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens, up to 90% savings with prompt caching and 50% with batch processing; US-only inference at 1.1x pricing.
- Effort settings let users control how hard the model works. Use cases: advanced coding, AI agents, enterprise workflows.
- Customer quotes (Devin, Cursor, Zapier, Lovable, Box and others): Lovable says agentic coding tasks up 22% over Opus 4.7; Box says Opus 5 outperforms Opus 4.8 by 8%; Zapier says it hit 100% on AutomationBench.

wikis.title: Introducing GPT-5.3-Codex
wikis.summary: OpenAI's February 5, 2026 launch of GPT-5.3-Codex, its most capable agentic coding model, with benchmarks, cybersecurity safeguards and availability.
wikis.body:
- Published February 5, 2026. "The most capable agentic coding model to date", combining GPT-5.2-Codex coding performance with GPT-5.2 reasoning and professional knowledge; 25% faster.
- "Our first model that was instrumental in creating itself": the Codex team used early versions to debug its training, manage deployment, and diagnose test results.
- Benchmarks (GPT-5.3-Codex xhigh vs GPT-5.2-Codex vs GPT-5.2): SWE-Bench Pro (Public) 56.8% / 56.4% / 55.6%; Terminal-Bench 2.0 77.3% / 64.0% / 62.2%; OSWorld-Verified 64.7% / 38.2% / 37.9% (humans ~72%); GDPval wins or ties 70.9% (matches GPT-5.2); Cybersecurity CTF 77.6% / 67.4% / 67.7%; SWE-Lancer IC Diamond 81.4% / 76.0% / 74.6%.
- Built two games autonomously over millions of tokens (racing game with eight maps; diving game).
- Interactive: can be steered while working (Settings > General > Follow-up behavior in the Codex app).
- Cyber: first model classified High capability for cybersecurity under the Preparedness Framework and first trained to identify vulnerabilities; some elevated-risk requests may be routed to GPT-5.2; Trusted Access for Cyber pilot; $10M in API credits committed; expanding Aardvark private beta; free scanning for open-source projects such as Next.js.
- Availability: paid ChatGPT plans in the Codex app, CLI, IDE extension and web; API "soon". Co-designed for, trained with and served on NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 systems.

wikis.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.6
wikis.summary: Anthropic's February 5, 2026 announcement of Claude Opus 4.6 with a 1M token context beta, benchmark results, new API controls, agent teams and safety findings.
wikis.body:
- Published Feb 5, 2026. Available on claude.ai, the API (claude-opus-4-6) and major cloud platforms. Pricing unchanged at $5/$25 per million tokens.
- First Opus-class model with a 1M token context window (beta, Claude Developer Platform only); premium pricing above 200k prompt tokens: $10/$37.50 per million input/output. Outputs up to 128k tokens. US-only inference at 1.1x token pricing.
- Results: highest score on Terminal-Bench 2.0; leads frontier models on Humanity's Last Exam; on GDPval-AA outperforms GPT-5.2 by around 144 Elo points and Opus 4.5 by 190; best on BrowseComp. MRCR v2 8-needle 1M: 76% vs Sonnet 4.5's 18.5%. BigLaw Bench 90.2%. Vending-Bench 2: earns $3,050.53 more than Opus 4.5.
- API features: adaptive thinking; four effort levels (low, medium, high default, max); context compaction (beta).
- Claude Code: agent teams as a research preview. Claude in Excel upgraded; Claude in PowerPoint in research preview for Max, Team and Enterprise.
- Safety: as well-aligned as Opus 4.5, lowest over-refusal rate of recent Claude models; six new cybersecurity probes; the company says it "may institute real-time intervention to block abuse".
- Footnote update Feb 23, 2026: HLE with tools score changed from 53.1% to 53.0%.
- Early access partners (Notion, Windsurf, Box, Lovable and others) gave quotes; Box reported 68% vs 58% baseline.

wikis.title: Introducing GPT-5.4 mini and nano
wikis.summary: OpenAI's March 17, 2026 release of GPT-5.4 mini and nano, small models for coding and subagents, with benchmarks, pricing and availability.
wikis.body:
- Published March 17, 2026. "Our most capable small models yet".
- GPT-5.4 mini: more than 2x faster than GPT-5 mini, approaches GPT-5.4 on SWE-Bench Pro and OSWorld-Verified. GPT-5.4 nano: smallest, cheapest; suggested for classification, data extraction, ranking and coding subagents.
- Benchmarks (GPT-5.4 / mini / nano / GPT-5 mini): SWE-Bench Pro 57.7 / 54.4 / 52.4 / 45.7%; Terminal-Bench 2.0 75.1 / 60.0 / 46.3 / 38.2%; GPQA Diamond 93.0 / 88.0 / 82.8 / 81.6%; OSWorld-Verified 75.0 / 72.1 / 39.0 / 42.0%.
- Pricing: mini $0.75 per 1M input and $4.50 per 1M output tokens, 400k context window; nano $0.20 input and $1.25 output per 1M tokens, API only.
- Availability: mini in the API, Codex and ChatGPT. In Codex it uses 30% of the GPT-5.4 quota (about one-third the cost) and can run as subagents. In ChatGPT, Free and Go users get it via "Thinking" in the + menu; others as rate limit fallback for GPT-5.4 Thinking.
- Hebbia CTO quote: mini matched or exceeded competitive models on several tasks at much lower cost.

wikis.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.7
wikis.summary: Anthropic's April 16, 2026 announcement of Claude Opus 4.7, with better vision and instruction following, new effort and task-budget controls, cyber safeguards and migration notes.
wikis.body:
- Published Apr 16, 2026; generally available across Claude products, API (claude-opus-4-7), Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry. Pricing same as Opus 4.6: $5 per million input and $25 per million output tokens.
- Notable improvement on Opus 4.6 in advanced software engineering, but "less broadly capable than our most powerful model, Claude Mythos Preview".
- Cyber: first model to carry new cyber safeguards that automatically detect and block prohibited or high-risk cybersecurity requests, following Project Glasswing; Cyber Verification Program for security professionals.
- Vision: images up to 2,576 pixels on the long edge (~3.75 megapixels), more than three times prior Claude models. Instruction following is more literal, so prompts may need re-tuning. Better file-system memory. State of the art on Finance Agent and GDPval-AA.
- Tester figures: CursorBench 70% vs Opus 4.6's 58%; XBOW visual acuity 98.5% vs 54.5%; Harvey BigLaw Bench 90.9% at high effort; Rakuten-SWE-Bench resolves 3x more production tasks; Databricks OfficeQA Pro 21% fewer errors.
- New xhigh effort level between high and max; Claude Code default effort raised to xhigh; task budgets in public beta on the API; /ultrareview command in Claude Code (three free ultrareviews for Pro and Max); auto mode extended to Max users.
- Migration: updated tokenizer maps the same input to roughly 1.0-1.35x more tokens; more thinking at higher effort.
- Safety: similar profile to Opus 4.6; alignment assessment says "largely well-aligned and trustworthy, though not fully ideal"; Mythos Preview remains best-aligned.
- Note dated May 4, 2026: Document reasoning graph updated for OfficeQA Pro scores.

wikis.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.8
wikis.summary: Anthropic's May 28, 2026 announcement of Claude Opus 4.8 with honesty improvements, dynamic workflows in Claude Code, effort control in claude.ai, cheaper fast mode and pricing.
wikis.body:
- Published May 28, 2026. Builds on Opus 4.7; same price: $5 per million input and $25 per million output tokens. Fast mode (2.5x speed) priced at $10/$50 per million tokens and "three times cheaper than it was for previous models". API name claude-opus-4-8.
- Honesty: around four times less likely than its predecessor to let flaws in its own code pass unremarked; alignment assessment says misaligned behavior is substantially lower than Opus 4.7 and similar to Claude Mythos Preview.
- Launching alongside: dynamic workflows (research preview in Claude Code for Enterprise, Team, Max) where Claude runs hundreds of parallel subagents, e.g. codebase-scale migrations across hundreds of thousands of lines; effort control in claude.ai and Cowork on all plans; Messages API accepts system entries inside the messages array.
- Defaults to high effort; "extra" (xhigh in Claude Code) or max for harder tasks; Claude Code rate limits increased.
- Tester quotes: Online-Mind2Web 84% (Opus 4.8); Databricks Genie 61% cheaper token cost than Opus 4.7; Legal Agent Benchmark first model to break 10% on the all-pass standard.
- Footnotes: OSWorld-Verified Opus 4.7 score updated to 82.3%; GPT-5.5 Terminal-Bench 2.1 with Codex CLI harness is 83.4%.
- What's next: cheaper models with Opus-like capability, and a new class of model above Opus; Claude Mythos Preview in use by a small number of organizations under Project Glasswing, with Mythos-class models expected for all customers "in the coming weeks".

wikis.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5
wikis.summary: Anthropic's July 24, 2026 announcement of Claude Opus 5, with benchmark results, alignment and cyber safeguards, pricing and new API beta features.
wikis.body:
- Published Jul 24, 2026. Available on all platforms; API name claude-opus-5. Price $5 per million input and $25 per million output tokens, same as Opus 4.8. Fast mode (about 2.5x speed) at twice the base price on the Claude Platform.
- Positioned as coming "close to the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price"; new default model on Claude Max and strongest on Claude Pro. Remains behind Mythos 5 on cybersecurity tasks.
- State of the art on Frontier-Bench and GDPval-AA; on Frontier-Bench v0.1 more than doubles Opus 4.8's performance at lower cost per task; CursorBench 3.2 at max effort within 0.5% of Fable 5's peak at half the cost; ARC-AGI 3 score three times the next-best model; Zapier AutomationBench pass rate around 1.5x next-best; OSWorld 2.0 beats Fable 5's best at just over a third of the cost.
- Life sciences: better than Opus 4.8 on every eval; organic chemistry +10.2 percentage points, protein-related tasks +7.7.
- Alignment: "our most aligned model to date"; misaligned behavior score 2.3, lowest of recent models.
- Cyber: no cyber-task training; near Mythos 5 at finding vulnerabilities on OSS-Fuzz but far behind at exploit development. Classifiers block binary-based vulnerability scanning, penetration testing and exploit generation; expected to intervene about 85% less often than for Fable 5; flagged requests fall back to Opus 4.8 by default in Claude.ai, Claude Code and Cowork. Cyber Verification Program members get a less restricted version.
- Biology: requests blocked on Fable 5 now route to Opus 5.
- Beta updates: mid-conversation tool changes without invalidating prompt cache; automatic fallbacks on the API.
- Customer quotes (Devin, Cursor, Zapier, Lovable, Box and others), e.g. Lovable: agentic coding up 22% over Opus 4.7; Box: 8% over Opus 4.8.

wikis.title: AIandBlockchain podcast: OpenAI's o1 models and their system card
wikis.summary: Episode description (October 7, 2024) of a 16-minute discussion of OpenAI's o1-preview and o1-mini based on excerpts from the September 12 system card, covering chain-of-thought reasoning and safety risks.
wikis.body:

- Based on excerpts from OpenAI's system card (September 12th).

wikis.title: The OpenAI Daily Brief, Jan 31, 2025: o3-mini, National Laboratories, SoftBank and Stargate
wikis.summary: A 15-minute news brief covering the o3-mini launch, free o1 in Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI's U.S. National Laboratories partnership, and SoftBank's reported investment and the Stargate venture.
wikis.body:
- Show: The OpenAI Daily Brief, episode 26; published January 31, 2025; 15 min. Segments: o3-mini launch (0:26), o1 on Microsoft Copilot (2:49), National Laboratories (5:29), political shifts (7:23), SoftBank and Stargate (9:31), valuation (12:12).
## o3-mini
- Now in ChatGPT and the API; "for the first time" a version is free to ChatGPT users with rate limits. Responses 24 percent faster than o1-mini with better accuracy; strong in math, coding and science; shows its reasoning. API access via Chat Completions, Assistants and Batch APIs; paid users can pick o3-mini-high; supports search with linked web sources.
## o1 in Copilot
- Microsoft's "Think Deeper" feature now free for all Copilot users (announced by Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman on LinkedIn); takes about 30 seconds; OpenAI reports o1 solves 83 percent of International Mathematics Olympiad problems. Context: rising popularity of DeepSeek and its security issues.
## National Laboratories
- Partnership to give approximately 15,000 scientists access to o1 and other o-series models via Venado, an Nvidia supercomputer at Los Alamos supported by Microsoft; areas include materials science, renewable energy, astrophysics, nuclear security. The labs' annual research funding is over $16 billion.
- Also mentions ChatGPT Gov and President Trump's executive order altering safety approaches.
## SoftBank, Stargate and valuation
- SoftBank "is considering" a $25 billion investment in OpenAI; Stargate joint venture to build AI data centers in Texas with initial funding expected to reach $100 billion, possibly increasing fivefold; SoftBank direct investment could exceed $40 billion combined with Stargate, per reports. Partners named: Microsoft, NVIDIA, Arm, MGX. Microsoft has invested $13 billion. OpenAI valuation stated as $340 billion.

wikis.title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia will sell twice as many chips next year
wikis.summary: CNBC, September 17, 2026: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang forecasts doubling chip sales next year, speaking ahead of an AI safety summit in Scotland.
wikis.body:
- Published Thu, Sep 17 2026 (updated same day), by Kif Leswing.
- Huang: "I expect Nvidia to sell twice as many chips as this next year as we do this year", said to media before a summit with King Charles III in Scotland. Reason given: AI's contribution to industries and economies, with people in almost every country wanting to invest in AI.
- Follows Nvidia's earlier statement that it expects 70% growth in the fiscal year ending January 2028, "about $673 billion".
- Nvidia does not disclose total chip numbers. Products named: Blackwell and Rubin data center GPUs, CPUs, switch chips, optical networking chips, laptop chips, Jetson chips, the chip in Nintendo's Switch 2. Last fall Huang said Nvidia shipped 6 million Blackwell GPUs in four quarters.
- Summit included representatives from Google DeepMind, OpenAI and Anthropic; Huang was in the U.K. to discuss AI safety: "When a product is not safe, we should hold it back and keep engineering it."

wikis.title: Nvidia GTC Washington DC 2025: Blackwell in Arizona, Nokia, quantum
wikis.summary: CNBC, October 28, 2025: at GTC in Washington, Jensen Huang said Blackwell GPUs are in full production in Arizona and announced Nokia, NVQLink and Department of Energy deals.
wikis.body:
- Published Tue, Oct 28 2025 by Kif Leswing.
- Huang said Blackwell GPUs are in full production in Arizona; previously Nvidia's fastest GPUs were made solely in Taiwan. Earlier that month Nvidia and TSMC announced first Blackwell wafers in Phoenix; Blackwell systems will also be assembled in the U.S. Huang said President Trump asked him nine months earlier to bring manufacturing back.
- Demand: 6 million Blackwell GPUs shipped in the last four quarters; Nvidia expects $500 billion in GPU sales between Blackwell and next year's Rubin.
- Nokia: partnership to build telecom gear (industry worth $3 trillion per Huang); Nvidia takes a $1 billion stake in Nokia; new product Nvidia ARC combining Grace GPU, Blackwell GPU and networking.
- Quantum: NVQLink connects quantum chips to Nvidia GPUs; 17 quantum startups to produce compatible hardware. Nvidia to partner with the Department of Energy on seven new supercomputers.
- Export controls: in April the U.S. required a license for the H20 to China; in May Nvidia said it would have recorded about $10.5 billion in H20 sales over two quarters; the administration said it would approve licenses with 15% of China sales paid to the U.S. government; Huang said Nvidia is "100% out of China".
- Huang said the conference was held in Washington so Trump could attend; Trump planned to meet Huang on Wednesday per Reuters.

wikis.title: NVIDIA dismisses AI bubble concerns, reportedly projects $500B in GPU sales
wikis.summary: TrendForce News, October 29, 2025, summarizing NVIDIA's Washington GTC: $500B Blackwell and Rubin GPU projection, China stance, Blackwell in Arizona and the Vera Rubin superchip.
wikis.body:
- Published 2025-10-29 (TrendForce News, citing CNBC, Reuters, gurufocus and TechNews). NVIDIA's first-ever Washington GTC ran October 27-29.
- Huang projected combined GPU revenue of $500 billion from Blackwell and next year's Rubin; 6 million Blackwell units shipped over four quarters. Per gurufocus, he expects 20 million units of the new generation vs 4 million of Hopper. Hyperscaler capex expected to rise 24% next year to nearly $550 billion (analysts, per CNBC).
- China: Huang said China has effectively blocked NVIDIA and the company has not sought export licenses for its latest processors: "They've made it very clear they don't want NVIDIA there right now." Share reportedly dropped from 95% to zero. In September China accused NVIDIA of breaking its anti-monopoly law.
- Blackwell GPUs made at TSMC in Arizona, servers assembled in Texas, networking built in California (Reuters).
- Vera Rubin superchip (per TechNews): one Vera CPU with two Rubin GPUs, up to 32 LPDDR memory channels, HBM4; each GPU reportedly has eight HBM4 interfaces and two reticle-sized dies; Vera CPU has 88 custom Arm cores, 176 threads. Rubin mass production expected in the third or fourth quarter of 2026.

wikis.title: Nvidia GTC 2026 keynote: $1 trillion Blackwell and Vera Rubin orders, Groq 3 LPU, Kyber
wikis.summary: CNBC report on Jensen Huang's March 16, 2026 GTC keynote, covering $1 trillion in expected Blackwell and Vera Rubin orders through 2027 and new chips, racks and partnerships.
wikis.body:
- Published Mon, Mar 16 2026 (updated Mar 20 2026). Keynote at the SAP Center in San Jose, California.
- CEO Jensen Huang said he expects purchase orders between Blackwell and Vera Rubin to reach **$1 trillion through 2027**; last year the company projected a $500 billion revenue opportunity. CFO Colette Kress said after last month's earnings that growth this year is expected to exceed that estimate. Shares rose about 2% Monday.
- Nvidia is worth about $4.5 trillion; said in February that revenue this quarter would rise about 77% to roughly $78 billion; 11 straight quarters of revenue growth above 55%.
- **Vera Rubin**: scheduled to roll out "later this year"; 1.3 million components; claimed 10 times more performance per watt than Grace Blackwell.
- **Groq 3 Language Processing Unit (LPU)**: first chip from Groq, mostly acquired via a $20 billion asset purchase in December (Nvidia's largest deal); expected to ship in the third quarter. The **Groq 3 LPX rack** holds 256 LPUs, sits beside Vera Rubin, and Huang said it can raise tokens-per-watt of Rubin GPUs by 35 times.
- **Kyber**: prototype next rack architecture after Rubin, 144 GPUs in vertical compute trays; to be in **Vera Rubin Ultra**, expected to ship in 2027.
- **OpenClaw / NemoClaw**: about two hours in, Huang discussed OpenClaw (launched January by Peter Steinberger, who joined OpenAI last month) and introduced NemoClaw, a reference stack to make it "enterprise ready".
- **Automotive**: Uber will launch a fleet on Nvidia Drive AV software across 28 cities on four continents by 2028, starting with Los Angeles and San Francisco next year. Nissan, BYD, Geely, Isuzu and Hyundai are building level 4 vehicles on Drive Hyperion; Isuzu and Japan's Tier IV are building autonomous buses.

wikis.title: Nvidia forecasts 70% fiscal 2028 revenue growth
wikis.summary: CNBC on Nvidia's Q2 fiscal 2027 earnings call where CFO Colette Kress forecast 70% growth for fiscal 2028, well above analyst estimates.
wikis.body:
- Published Wed, Aug 26 2026 (updated Aug 27).
- On the second-quarter fiscal 2027 earnings call, CFO Colette Kress said fiscal 2028 revenue growth will reach **70%**, versus a 44% average analyst estimate (LSEG). Fiscal 2028 ends Feb. 1, 2028.
- With consensus fiscal 2027 revenue of $396 billion, sales would hit $673 billion, ahead of Apple and Alphabet per Wall Street projections and behind only Amazon among U.S. tech companies.
- Revenue doubled in the latest quarter from a year earlier. Guidance could have been higher but for supply constraints (e.g. memory shortages).
- Jensen Huang: "Our demand is much greater than 70%... Our supply allows us to confidently deliver 70%." He gave the forecast because he has visibility into next year's compute needs and wanted partners providing land and power to have the same information.
- Demand is shifting from a few hyperscalers/frontier labs to a wider base; Huang called a new customer category "ACIE" (regional AI companies, neoclouds, startups, enterprises). Earlier in August Nvidia announced a program to help such companies and frontier labs access financing from six major financial firms.

wikis.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-5
wikis.summary: OpenAI's August 7, 2025 launch post for GPT-5, a unified system with a router and thinking model, plus benchmarks, safety changes and availability.
wikis.body:
- Dated August 7, 2025. GPT-5 is a unified system: a smart, efficient model, a deeper reasoning model (GPT-5 thinking), and a real-time router choosing between them. Once limits are reached a mini version handles queries.
- New default in ChatGPT, replacing GPT-4o, o3, o4-mini, GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.5 for signed-in users. Rolling out to Plus, Pro, Team and Free users "today"; Enterprise and Edu "next week". Pro gets unlimited use and **GPT-5 pro** (replacing o3-pro); free users fall back to GPT-5 mini. Usable in Codex CLI for Pro, Plus, Team.
- Benchmarks: 94.6% AIME 2025 (no tools), 74.9% SWE-bench Verified, 88% Aider Polyglot, 84.2% MMMU, 46.2% HealthBench Hard; GPT-5 pro 88.4% GPQA.
- Efficiency: GPT-5 thinking beats o3 with 50-80% fewer output tokens.
- Reliability: ~45% fewer factual errors than GPT-4o (with web search); ~80% fewer than o3 when thinking; deception rate on production reasoning traffic 4.8% (o3) to 2.1%. o3 answered confidently about non-existent images 86.7% vs 9% for GPT-5.
- Sycophancy cut from 14.5% to under 6% on targeted evals. New "safe completions" safety training. "GPT-5 thinking" treated as High capability in biological and chemical domain with safeguards (5,000 hours of red-teaming).
- Four preset personalities (Cynic, Robot, Listener, Nerd) in research preview.
- GPT-5 pro: experts preferred it over GPT-5 thinking 67.8% of the time; 22% fewer major errors. Trained on Microsoft Azure AI supercomputers.

wikis.title: OpenAI debuts GPT-4o 'omni' model

- Published May 13, 2024. GPT-4o ("omni") handles text, speech and video; rolling out "iteratively" over the next few weeks. CTO Mira Murati: "GPT-4o reasons across voice, text and vision."
- ChatGPT voice becomes real-time, can be interrupted, picks up on vocal nuance; improved vision (photos, desktop screen). Better in around 50 languages.
- API/Azure: twice as fast, half the price and higher rate limits than GPT-4 Turbo. Audio in the API first to "a small group of trusted partners" in coming weeks.
- Free tier gets GPT-4o today; Plus and Team get "5x higher" message limits. New ChatGPT voice in alpha for Plus in about a month.
- Also: refreshed web UI, macOS desktop app (Plus first, Windows later in the year), GPT Store opened to free users, and memory, file/photo upload and web search for free users.

wikis.title: OpenAI explains why ChatGPT became too sycophantic
wikis.summary: TechCrunch, April 29 2025, on OpenAI's postmortem of the GPT-4o update that made ChatGPT overly agreeable and was rolled back.
wikis.body:
- Published April 29, 2025. OpenAI published a postmortem on sycophancy in GPT-4o after rolling back an update released the previous week.
- Users noticed the over-validating behavior over the weekend; Sam Altman acknowledged it Sunday and two days later announced the rollback.
- OpenAI said the update, meant to make the default personality "feel more intuitive and effective", was informed too much by "short-term feedback" and "did not fully account for how users' interactions with ChatGPT evolve over time."
- Fixes: refine training and system prompts, add guardrails for "honesty and transparency", expand evaluations, let users give "real-time feedback" and choose multiple personalities, and explore "broader, democratic feedback".

- Described as an early foray into AI agents; OpenAI reportedly preparing "Operator" (Bloomberg said possibly within weeks).

wikis.title: Doraemon (2005 TV series)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on the 2005 Doraemon anime by Shin-Ei Animation and TV Asahi: production, voice recast, English dubs, episode counts, themes and films.
wikis.body:
- Japanese sci-fi comedy anime based on Fujiko F. Fujio's manga; third adaptation after the 1973 and 1979 anime. Produced by Shin-Ei Animation, TV Asahi and ADK Emotions; premiered April 15, 2005 (one-hour special) on TV Asahi/ANN and airs in over fifty countries. Called the "Mizuta Edition" in Asia after Wasabi Mizuta, Doraemon's voice.
- Scale: infobox says 22 seasons, 915 episodes (1,750+ segments), 20-26 min; text says 892 episodes, 45 feature films and a 46th set for spring 2027.
- Premise: Doraemon, a cat-like robot from the 22nd century, is sent to Tokyo to help 10-year-old Nobita Nobi. Others: Shizuka Minamoto, Suneo Honekawa, Takeshi "Gian" Goda.
- Japanese cast: Wasabi Mizuta (Doraemon), Megumi Ohara (Nobita), Yumi Kakazu (Shizuka), Tomokazu Seki (Suneo), Subaru Kimura (Gian). Directors: Soichiro Zen 2005-2017, Shinnosuke Yakuwa 2017-2018, Hirofumi Ogura 2020-present. Music Kan Sawada.
- Production: revival development began 2004 for the 1979 anime's 25th anniversary; trailer first shown March 25, 2005. The five-actor recast (announced March 13, 2005) was chosen from 590 applicants after Nobuyo Oyama, 1979 Doraemon voice, wished to step down. Kimura was 14 when cast. Look overhauled with more vivid colours from July 28, 2017. Aired Fridays 7:00 pm until September 29, 2017; since October 5, 2019 Saturdays 5:00 pm. Recorded at APU Meguro Studio.
- Changes from manga: episodes extended for better conclusions; medicine-like gadgets changed; Nobita's dad rarely smokes.
- English dubs: Bang Zoom!/Viz Media "Doraemon: Gadget Cat from the Future" on Disney XD, July 7, 2014 to September 1, 2015 (2 seasons, 52 episodes), heavily localized; Red Angel Media (Hong Kong, LUK International) on Boomerang UK from August 2015 to January 2016 (about 26 episodes); EarCandy (South Africa, Spacetoon India) on Disney Channel India from February 4, 2020, Disney Channel HD August 14, 2023 to May 10, 2025, three actors; fourth dub by Cake Entertainment announced June 2026, no release date given.
- Episodes per year (examples): 2005 32; 2020 52; 2023 48; 2024 47; 2025 49; 2026 TBA (from January 10, 2026).
- Openings: eight in Japanese; "Doraemon no Uta" (12 Girls Band) from April 15, 2005, "Hagushichao" (Rimi Natsukawa) from October 28, 2005, "Yume wo Kanaete Doraemon" (Mao) from May 11, 2007; as of November 2024 the current opening is "Yume wo Kanaete Doraemon" again.
- Mini corners: Doraemon Mini Theater (April-July 2005), Dora Dora Mini Theater (October-December 2022). Tribute: after Nobuyo Oyama died on September 29, 2024, a rerun episode was replaced by a montage of 1979 clips.
- Films listed include Nobita's Art World Tales (2025), New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil (2026), Nobita's Steam-Powered Time Machine (2027).

wikis.title: Kaiju No. 8: synopsis, production, media, anime and reception
wikis.summary: Article body on Naoya Matsumoto's manga Kaiju No. 8, its spin-offs, Production I.G anime seasons and sales.
wikis.body:
- Web manga by Naoya Matsumoto (English also "Monster #8"), Shueisha Shonen Jump+, July 3, 2020 to July 18, 2025 (129th chapter); 16 volumes, first December 4, 2020, last September 4, 2025. Viz Media English digital from August 2, 2020, print from December 7, 2021 (licensed February 19, 2021); Manga Plus from July 22, 2020. Over 20 million copies in circulation by September 2026.
- Story: kaiju attack Japan; Kafka Hibino swallows a parasitic creature and can become a kaiju ("Kaiju No. 8") while joining the Japanese Anti-Kaiju Defense Force to keep a promise to childhood friend Mina Ashiro (Third Division captain). Allies: Reno Ichikawa, Kikoru Shinomiya; First Division captain Gen Narumi; vice-captain Soshiro Hoshina. Antagonist Kaiju No. 9, later the Meireki entity; Kafka helps defeat it and is later allowed to use his kaiju form when necessary.
- Production: outline pitched near end of 2018; influenced by Ultraman (esp. Ultraseven), Shin Godzilla, Pacific Rim; Kaiju No. 8's design modelled on oni.
- Spin-offs: light novel "Exclusive on the Third Division" (Keiji Ando, November 4, 2022); "B-Side" manga (January 5 to July 12, 2024, 2 volumes); "Kaiju No. 8 Relax" (from June 4, 2024, Saikyo Jump); Jump Toon vertical edition from September 1, 2025; a video game.
- Anime: announced August 4, 2022; Production I.G, Studio Khara supervised kaiju designs; directors Shigeyuki Miya and Tomomi Kamiya; scripts Ichiro Okouchi; music Yuta Bandoh. Season 1 April 13 to June 29, 2024 on TV Tokyo; season 2 July 19 to September 27, 2025; compilation film plus "Hoshina's Day Off" from March 28, 2025 (released abroad as "Kaiju No. 8: Mission Recon"); Crunchyroll streams; Medialink for Southeast Asia. Shorts "Minute! Kaiju No. 8" from December 6, 2024.
- December 2025: a "conclusion arc" and short "Narumi's Week at Work" announced; the short premiered on September 5, 2026 and "will run for four episodes".
- Reception: 100 million views by April 2021, 400 million by February 2023; won the 2021 Next Manga Award (web) and was nominated for a 2022 Eisner Award; School Library Journal top 10 manga of 2021; Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2022 third place. Vol. 1 first week 90,831 copies in Japan.

wikis.title: Beyblade X (Wikipedia)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on Beyblade X, the fourth-generation Beyblade toyline with a CoroCoro Comic manga, OLM anime, video games, characters and season schedule.
wikis.body:
## Overview
- Japanese manga, anime and toyline based on Takara Tomy and ADK Emotions' Beyblade franchise; the fourth generation of the franchise.
- Toyline launched July 15, 2023; manga serialized in Shogakukan's CoroCoro Comic since May 15, 2023 (9 volumes); anime by OLM premiered on TV Tokyo and affiliates October 6, 2023.
- ADK Emotions NY, Inc. and T-Licensing released the anime in English in 2024.

## Plot
Amateur Blader Robin Kazami (Bird Kazami in Japanese) is ditched by his friends after a crushing defeat. A chance encounter with former champion Jaxon Cross leads to a team-up; Jaxon intends to climb back to the top of The X as "Blader X" and challenge champion Khrome Ryugu. With influencer Multi Nana-iro, they form Team Persona and aim to go pro.

## Manga
- Written by Homura Kawamoto and Hikaru Muno, illustrated by Posuka Demizu; Viz Media announced an English licence in May 2024 (vol. 1 January 14, 2025); Shogakukan Asia publishes an English version in Singapore.

## Anime
- Announced May 14, 2023; OLM Team Masuda; directed by Moto Terada, Dai Fukuyama from episode 101, Katsuhito Akiyama supervising to episode 100; 134 episodes as of September 18, 2026.
- Season 1 OP "Prove" by One Ok Rock, ED "Zoom Zoom" by Aespa. Season 2 announced September 13, 2024, began October 18, 2024 (OP "You Gotta Run" by L'Arc-en-Ciel; ED "Cosmic Treat" by Perfume; later OP "Rise" by Tomorrow X Together, ED "Stay Gold" by Ado and Jax Jones). Season 3 announced September 12, 2025, began October 24, 2025 (OP "Invincible" by i-dle, ED "Vortex" by imase).
- After episode 122 the series left TV Tokyo and moved to the Beyblade YouTube channel on April 17, 2026 with a two-episode premiere, then a biweekly schedule. "A fourth season will premiere on October 9, 2026."
- English dub of season 1 premiered at Anime Expo on July 6, 2024, on Disney XD, DisneyNow and Hulu in the US July 13, 2024; season 2 dub premiered July 26, 2025.

## Video games
- BEYBLADE X XONE (GrooveBoxJapan/FuRyu; Switch, Windows), November 14, 2024; BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE, November 13, 2025.

## Main characters (Japanese / English voice)
Jaxon Cross (Soma Saito / AJ Beckles), Robin Kazami (Shuichiro Umeda / Caleb Yen), Multi Nana-iro (Ruriko Noguchi / Anairis Quinones), Tenka Shiroboshi (Yuko Natsuyoshi / Justine Lee), Nine Cross; many teams (Pendragon, Phalanx, Zooganic, Yggdrasil, Gordius, Zodiac, Misleaders) are listed.

wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on the Japanese light novel series by Yu Hibari, its manga, and the Project No.9 TV anime that premiered July 6, 2026.
wikis.body:
## Plot
Childhood friends Hayato Kirishima and Haruki Nikaido separated after Haruki moved away. Seven years later Hayato transfers to a city school and meets a beautiful girl who is Haruki, formerly tomboyish. They reconnect and start a relationship.

## Characters (anime voice)
- Hayato Kirishima (Shun'ichi Toki); Haruki Nikaido (Ikumi Hasegawa), daughter of actress Mao Takura; Himeko Kirishima (Miharu Hanai), Hayato's younger sister; Minamo Mitake (Natsumi Haruse); Saki Murao (Fuka Izumi); Mao Takura (Yuko Kaida). Voice drama cast: Ryota Osaka and Rikako Aida.

## Light novels
- Written by Yu Hibari; serialized on Shosetsuka ni Naro from June 13, 2020 to July 31, 2026; Kadokawa Shoten (Sneaker Bunko) published eleven volumes with illustrations by Shiso from February 27, 2021 to July 31, 2026.

## Manga
- Illustrated by Kina Oyama; serialized by Fujimi Shobo on Niconico Seiga (Dra Dra Flat) from September 2, 2021 to June 26, 2025; seven volumes from April 8, 2022 to July 9, 2025.

## Anime
- Announced at Kadokawa's "Sneaker Bunko 35th Anniversary Festa!" livestream on September 24, 2023; produced by Project No.9, directed by Xu Chuan Feng; series composition Deko Akao; character design N-Nei Kurahashi; music Ryosuke Nakanishi, Naoki Tani, Yuri Morita.
- Premiered July 6, 2026 on Tokyo MX and other networks; Crunchyroll streams it. Opening "Natsu ni Kasanete" by Dialogue+; ending "Tilt" by Harmoe.

wikis.title: Second season of Mahou Shoujo ni Akogarete announced
wikis.summary: MyAnimeList news of Oct 5, 2024 that the Mahoako event announced a second season of the Mahou Shoujo ni Akogarete (Gushing over Magical Girls) TV anime.
wikis.body:
## Announcement
- The Mahoako SM (Sugoku Moriagatta yo) Dai Kansha-sai event announced a second season of the television anime on Saturday (article dated Oct 5, 2024). No air date, studio or staff for season 2 given.
- Official site: mahoako-anime.com; official X @mahoako_anime; source Comic Natalie.

## Background
- First season by Asahi Production aired in Winter 2024; Sentai Filmworks licensed and simulcast it on HIDIVE with subtitles and dub.
- Adapts Akihiro Ononaka's comedy fantasy manga, begun on the Manga Life STORIA Dash website in March 2019; Takeshobo published volume 11 on January 17; J-Novel Club licensed it in English (digital) in March 2022, ninth volume on sale January 24.
- Synopsis: Tres Magia, a team of three magical girls, protects Utena Hiiragi's town. A black mascot lets Utena become a magical girl, but she has been recruited by an evil organization to fight the girls she admires, and she finds sadistic pleasure in it.

wikis.title: Gushing over Magical Girls (Wikipedia)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on Akihiro Ononaka's magical girl manga Mahou Shoujo ni Akogarete, its 2024 Asahi Production anime and the announced second season.
wikis.body:
## Overview
- Japanese magical girl manga by Akihiro Ononaka (Mahou Shoujo ni Akogarete, also "I Admire Magical Girls, and..."), serialized on Takeshobo's Storia Dash from March 2019 (Manga Life Storia in 2019); thirteen volumes as of September 2026; licensed in English by J-Novel Club.

## Plot
Utena Hiiragi, an introverted girl who admires the magical-girl trio Tres Magia, is given powers by the mascot Venalita but becomes an evil general of the Enormita organization (as Magia Baiser). She discovers a sadistic side and revels in torturing her idols.

## Characters
- Utena Hiiragi / Magia Baiser (Fuka Izumi); Venalita (Misato Fukuen), who blackmails Utena with a video; Kiwi Araga / Leoparde (Aoi Koga), an Enormita member in love with Utena. Tres Magia's members' identities are unknown to Enormita and vice versa.

## Anime
- Announced March 16, 2023; Asahi Production; directed by Masato Suzuki and Atsushi Otsuki; series composition Noboru Kimura; music Yasuharu Takanashi, Akinari Suzuki, Johannes Nilsson.
- Aired January 3 to March 27, 2024 (13 episodes) on AT-X and other networks; censored on TV, partially uncensored on AT-X (censored audio), fully uncensored on home media.
- Opening "My Dream Girls" by Nacherry; ending "Togetoge Sadistic" by Fuka Izumi, Aoi Koga and Shiori Sugiura.
- Sentai Filmworks licensed it for North America, Australia and the British Isles (Hidive, Section23 Films).
- "A second season was announced during an event for the anime series on October 5, 2024."
